summary: Iter-171 FE testing for ExternalSponsorAutocomplete + In-System User Match banner on the Case Detail Sponsor section. Seeded a child + 2 cases sharing the same sponsor 'TESTITER171 Maria Lopez' so the autocomplete had a real hit with active_cases=2, then drove the full UI flow with Playwright. 11/12 spec items PASS; 1 functional bug found in the autocomplete empty-state rendering.

ui_bugs.issue:
Empty-state message ('No existing sponsors match — keep typing to register a new one') is dead code and never renders. Line 58 guards the dropdown Card with `open && (hits.length > 0 || loading)`. The empty-state

inside (line 77-79) requires `!loading && hits.length === 0`, which contradicts the outer guard — so when there are 0 hits and not loading, the whole Card is hidden and the user never sees the message. Spec explicitly calls this branch out.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: Change the outer condition to `open && (value && value.trim().length >= 2)` OR drop the `hits.length > 0 || loading` gate entirely and let the inner branches handle empty/loading/list states.

action_items: Fix empty-state visibility in ExternalSponsorAutocomplete — the spec's 'No existing sponsors match — keep typing to register a new one' message is currently unreachable due to a contradictory render guard.

(Optional UX) The 'Save name' button currently PUTs the entire current sponsor_manual block (name + email + phone + notes), not just the name. In the test flow it overwrote a guest's email with admin@5812uganda.org because the email field still held a previous value when Save name was clicked. Either rename the button to 'Save sponsor' or only send {name} on click to match the label.

(Optional) Add a DELETE /api/social-work/sponsors/external/{guest_id} endpoint (or admin sweep) so test-created guests can be cleaned up. Right now external_sponsor guests linger forever once dedup creates them.

SocialWorkPage.jsx L537-548: the sponsorUserMatch effect correctly debounces 400ms and does case-insensitive lookup against the prop `members`. Verified live with MIXED-CASE email — works. Good.

ExternalSponsorAutocomplete uses `onMouseDown` on each hit instead of `onClick` so the parent Input's onBlur doesn't close the dropdown before the click is registered — nice. (Test confirmed by dispatching 'mousedown'.)
The autocomplete component swallows API errors with `catch { setHits([]); }` (line 30) — fine for UX (no toast spam) but worth a one-line warn in dev so flakes don't go silent.

rca of the issue:
Bug: dead empty-state branch in ExternalSponsorAutocomplete.jsx. Lines 58 and 77 have contradictory conditions: outer requires hits.length>0||loading, inner empty-state requires hits.length===0&&!loading. Intersection is the empty set — the empty-state

can never render. RCA: classic case of two render branches written separately without checking the parent gate. Mitigation: relax the outer Card condition to render whenever the dropdown is open (or whenever the query is ≥2 chars), and let the inner branches handle empty/loading/list. Suggested patch: `{open && (value || '').trim().length >= 2 && ( ... ) }` — that way both the loading spinner, hit list, AND empty-state can show as intended.
